explainBack.question: If the mode choice is gone, why does Anthropic still make me pick between Manual and Auto in every conversation?
explainBack.answer: Merging chat and Cowork removed the doorway that routed tasks by length, but longer tasks still involve Claude taking actions on files or apps. Because actions carry risk regardless of which door you entered, the permission setting — Manual asks before each action, Auto reduces check-ins — now governs the whole conversation instead, so the safety decision moved from the entrance to the conversation itself.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: An accurate answer must distinguish the removed mode choice from the retained per-conversation permission choice and state what Manual and Auto each do.
explainBack.assessment: The artifact supports this answer directly: P002 establishes the removed doorway, P005 explains Manual/Auto and the conversation-wide scope, and P008 compresses the distinction accurately.

unseenTransfer.scenario: A reader on a Pro plan wants Claude to sort five years of scanned utility bills stored on her laptop into folders by year and provider, then leave for a weekend trip while it works.
unseenTransfer.question: Can she close her laptop and expect the sorting to finish, and what settings should she choose?
unseenTransfer.answer: No — sorting files on her computer is local work, which per the article needs Claude Desktop open, so closing the laptop stops it; only cloud tasks continue after closure. She should keep the conversation on Manual so Claude asks before moving files, name exactly which folder it may touch, and spot-check the resulting sort against a few original bills before trusting it. If the merged experience has not reached her account yet, she uses Cowork for this job.
unseenTransfer.expectedEvidence: Correct application of the local-vs-cloud execution boundary (P007), the Manual permission choice and per-conversation scope (P005), and staged availability (P003).
unseenTransfer.assessment: The article's mechanism resolves this unseen case completely, confirming the local/cloud and permission explanations transfer beyond the appliance-manual example.
